instruction: I want to create a playlist for this video so I can easily access it later. Please help me create a playlist file named "playlist.m3u" containing this video and save it in the same directory as the video.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a playlist file containing the video using VLC. The evaluator checks if playlist.m3u file was created and contains reference to video.mp4. Similar complexity to original subtitle extraction task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both main instruction requirements: playlist.m3u file exists at /home/user/ and contains video.mp4 reference.
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter: uses expected.get('should_contain_video', True) to access rules dict directly (as returned by get_rule()).
Getter logic is robust: checks file existence, reads content, validates M3U format header (#EXTM3U), and detects video.mp4 reference in non-comment lines.
Video reference detection (lines 54-56) uses proper logic: checks if line contains 'video.mp4' AND either equals 'video.mp4' or ends with 'video.mp4', avoiding false positives from substring matches.
Getter extracts has_valid_m3u_format but metric doesn't use it - minor issue since instruction doesn't explicitly require M3U format validation, just creating a playlist file.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding M3U format validation to metric scoring (e.g., 33% file exists, 33% contains video, 34% valid M3U format) for more thorough verification.
Could make video reference check stricter by requiring proper path format (absolute or relative) rather than just checking if line ends with 'video.mp4'.
